rules.text:
# sfr rules file: core rules R1 to R6; R7 is N/A without [authorized_sources].
# Format reference: docs/SPEC.md B1.6. Unknown keys are rejected.
format = "sfr-rules/1"

[required_topics]
# R1 also checks the vehicle_status and failsafe_flags fields that R4 to R6 read.
topics = ["vehicle_status", "failsafe_flags"]

[parameters]
# "all": a parameter present only in the baseline or only in the log is a difference.
# "baseline": compare only the parameters the baseline lists.
compare = "all"

# R3 skips parameters matching these patterns. "*" matches any run of characters.
# Default list from docs/DIAGNOSTIC.md item 5 (two-flight experiment plus PX4 source).
ignore = [
  "COM_FLIGHT_UUID",   # per-flight identifier
  "LND_FLIGHT_T_HI",   # flight-time accumulator
  "LND_FLIGHT_T_LO",   # flight-time accumulator
  "EKF2_MAG_DECL",     # learned from position each flight
  "CAL_BARO*_OFF",     # rewritten by GNSS baro auto-calibration (v1.17)
  "ASPD_SCALE_*",      # airspeed scale learned in flight
  "COM_MODE*_HASH",    # external mode registration hashes (v1.15 and later)
]

# Watched parameters (SPEC B1.6): R3 compares them like every other parameter; the
# results table and the report show them in their own "Transition tuning" section, and the
# record lists them in config.watched_parameters. VTOL transition tuning; every name is defined
# in PX4 v1.14 and v1.17 (docs/DIAGNOSTIC.md item 12).
[watched_parameters]
names = [
  "VT_F_TRANS_DUR",    # front transition duration
  "VT_B_TRANS_DUR",    # maximum back transition duration
  "VT_TRANS_MIN_TM",   # front transition minimum time
  "VT_TRANS_TIMEOUT",  # front transition timeout
  "VT_ARSP_TRANS",     # transition airspeed
  "VT_PITCH_MIN",      # minimum pitch angle during hover
  "VT_FW_DIFTHR_EN",   # differential thrust in forward flight (bitmask)
  "VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_R",  # roll differential thrust factor
  "VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_P",  # pitch differential thrust factor
  "VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_Y",  # yaw differential thrust factor
]

# COMMAND events with these ids are category PAYLOAD; every other command is GENERAL.
# Ids and names from PX4's VehicleCommand.msg, the same in v1.14 and v1.17 (docs/DIAGNOSTIC.md
# item 12). Flight termination (185) and parachute (208) are safety commands and stay GENERAL.
[payload_commands]
ids = [
  184,    # VEHICLE_CMD_DO_REPEAT_SERVO
  187,    # VEHICLE_CMD_DO_SET_ACTUATOR
  203,    # VEHICLE_CMD_DO_DIGICAM_CONTROL
  206,    # VEHICLE_CMD_DO_SET_CAM_TRIGG_DIST
  211,    # VEHICLE_CMD_DO_GRIPPER
  214,    # VEHICLE_CMD_DO_SET_CAM_TRIGG_INTERVAL
  260,    # VEHICLE_CMD_OBLIQUE_SURVEY
  2000,   # VEHICLE_CMD_IMAGE_START_CAPTURE
  2003,   # VEHICLE_CMD_DO_TRIGGER_CONTROL
  30001,  # VEHICLE_CMD_PAYLOAD_PREPARE_DEPLOY
  30002,  # VEHICLE_CMD_PAYLOAD_CONTROL_DEPLOY
  42600,  # VEHICLE_CMD_DO_WINCH
]
